Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, b As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 110, 10: b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 60, 80: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 1
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 110, 10: b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 60, 80: b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 10, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 2
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 110, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 3
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 4
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingAuto, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 110, 10: b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 60, 80: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 5
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(3, 10, 10)
    Case 6
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(-1, 10, 10)
    Case 7
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentCurve, msoEditingCorner, 40, 60, 80, 60, 110, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 8
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentCurve, msoEditingCorner, 40, 60, 80, 60, 110, 10: b.AddNodes msoSegmentCurve, msoEditingCorner, 140, -20, 170, 40, 200, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 9
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentCurve, msoEditingCorner, 40, 60, 80, 60, 110, 10: b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 200, 50: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 10
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 200, 50: b.AddNodes msoSegmentCurve, msoEditingCorner, 40, 60, 80, 60, 110, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 11
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentCurve, msoEditingCorner, 40, 60, 80, 60, 10, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 12
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentCurve, msoEditingCorner, 40, 60: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 13
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentCurve, msoEditingAuto, 40, 60: b.AddNodes msoSegmentCurve, msoEditingAuto, 80, 60: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 14
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentCurve, msoEditingAuto, 40, 60, 80, 60, 110, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 15
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 40, 60, 80, 60, 110, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 16
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingCorner, 110, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 17
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes 9, msoEditingAuto, 110, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 18
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, 9, 110, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 19
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 110.5, 10.25: b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 60.75, 80.5: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 20
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 110, 10: b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 60, 80: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape: sh.Name = "Mine"
    Case 21
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 110, 10: b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 60, 80: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 22
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 10, 10): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 110, 10: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape: b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 60, 80: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 23
        Set b = ws.Shapes.BuildFreeform(msoEditingCorner, 50, 40): b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 10, 10: b.AddNodes msoSegmentLine, msoEditingAuto, 90, 5: Set sh = b.ConvertToShape
    Case 24
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 25
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 26
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(3, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 27
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(4, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 28
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(0, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 29
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(5, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 30
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(-2, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 31
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 32
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255
    Case 33
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.Line.Weight = 3
    Case 34
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.AutoShapeType = 1
    Case 35
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddCallout(2, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.TextFrame.Characters.Text = "Hi"
    End Select
    s = "ok"
Measured:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(b)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(sh)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.AutoShapeType
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Left
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Top
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Width
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Height
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.Shapes.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Line.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Adjustments.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Adjustments(1)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Adjustments(2)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Adjustments(3)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Adjustments(4)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.HorizontalFlip
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.VerticalFlip
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Measured
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 35
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
